name: tk
description: Session and engineering flow: kickoff (session open — the queue triaged, briefed and dispatched; afk/pack build an unattended package, --budget N its generations), wrap-up (session close on a fixed template: memory, docs, tests, and one versioning gate settling every commit/push/merge; afk commits and pushes before any review and merges only under the five safe-to-merge verdicts), dispatch (task → the mechanism that runs it unattended), verify (the item's acceptance criterion as the ruler of the delivery, with the evidence block the caller re-runs), review (one lens over a committed slice — the second pair of eyes before the mandatory two-axis review), fleet (one command runs every project's package on this machine, closing on one consolidated HTML vista), docs-audit (every doc against the code, and the project's auto-memory with it), second-opinion (a fresh Fable subagent judges what the session is discussing — once, or argued to consensus within a turn budget), prune (measures a skill against the writing-for-agents ruler and reports what to keep, move and drop). Site-specific integrations plug in via ~/.claude/tk/<skill>.md extension files.
